title: Superman 2 Cast: 5 Actors Seemingly Confirmed for Man of Tomorrow - NewsBreak
text:
By Shazmeen Navrange ,
3 minutes ago Photo Credit: Warner Bros. Pictures Curious about the Superman 2: Man of Tomorrow cast ? James Gunn recently shared an exciting update on what’s next for the Man of Steel. He took to Instagram to post an artwork by Jim Lee featuring Superman and Lex Luthor. In the caption, Gunn confirmed that the Superman sequel, Man of Tomorrow, will arrive in theaters on July 9, 2027.
The announcement has sparked major anticipation around which actors will appear in the follow-up. Here are the details.
5 actors possibly confirmed to be in Superman 2: Man of Tomorrow’s cast David Corenswet Corenswet reprises his role as Clark Kent/Superman in the upcoming sequel. He reposted the artwork on Instagram, confirming the title and release date. He had earlier revealed during a Vanity Fair lie detector test that he was already under contract for a sequel.
Nicholas Hoult Hoult returns as billionaire Lex Luthor. In the first movie’s ending, Superman exposed Lex’s schemes and had him arrested before he was taken to the Belle Reve Facility. Hoult also shared the Superman 2 announcement on social media, confirming his return.
Isabela Merced Merced is likely to reprise her role as Hawkgirl, a member of the Justice Gang. She appeared to confirm her return by commenting “See you soon” on Gunn’s post.
Aaron Pierre Pierre will play John Stewart in the upcoming Lanterns series. Although he was not in the first Superman film, he reacted to Gunn’s sequel announcement with “Yes, indeed,” hinting at possible involvement.
Frank Grillo Grillo plays Rick Flag Sr. He also shared the Man of Tomorrow news, subtly teasing his appearance in the sequel.
Other actors who are likely to return in Superman sequel These actors are rumored to reprise their roles, but their involvement has not been officially confirmed:
Rachel Brosnahan as Lois Lane Nathan Fillion as Guy Gardner Edi Gathegi as Michael Holt / Mister Terrific Anthony Carrigan as Rex Mason / Metamorpho Milly Alcock as Supergirl Krypto Mikaela Hoover as Cat Grant Skyler Gisondo as Jimmy Olsen Wendell Pierce as Perry White John Cena as Peacemaker Jason Momoa as Lobo Dr. Phosphorus Superman: Man of Tomorrow is set to release on July 9, 2027.
